info.text:
Pay in 4 is zero interest. So who pays?
16% of US adults used buy now, pay later in 2025, up from 10% in 2021.
A $200 buy = $50 at checkout, then $50 every two weeks for six weeks.
Stores pay the lender a fee on each sale, and 26% of users paid late in 2025. The average late fee was $9.99 in 2023.
Sources: Federal Reserve SHED (May 2026), CFPB (Dec 2025), FICO (June 2025).
News and education, not financial advice.
